meta.title: MCP Question Bank — Chapter 6: Client Best Practices (multi-select)
meta.revision: v2.1 (curated 2026-09-12, 200 items, verified against the 2026-07-28 specification)

questions.question: Which client-side practices does the guidance endorse? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Validate tool results against outputSchema before passing them to the model
Trust readOnlyHint annotations to decide which calls can skip confirmation
Follow $ref URLs in tool schemas so validation is always complete
Apply timeouts to tool calls and log usage for audit
Show the user a tool's inputs before sending the call

questions.explanation: A, B and C are the client SHOULDs in the tools spec. Implementations MUST NOT automatically dereference network $refs, and annotations are untrusted unless the server is trusted, so they cannot by themselves justify skipping consent.

questions.question: Which results may a client cache? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: A resources/read result for a specific uri, keyed by that uri
The result of a retry that carried inputResponses and requestState
A server/discover result carrying ttlMs and cacheScope
An InputRequiredResult, so the client can replay the prompt offline
A tools/list result with resultType complete and ttlMs 300000

questions.explanation: Cacheable results are the complete results of server/discover, the three list methods, resources/templates/list and resources/read, keyed by method plus the params that affect them. Interim input_required results carry no caching hints, and results produced by an MRTR retry MUST NOT be cached.

questions.question: Your client connects six servers. Which practices does the client guidance endorse around presenting and executing tool calls? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Show the user the tool and its arguments before a call is executed
Re-fetch every list on each turn so the model never sees stale data
Apply a timeout and cancel the request when it is exceeded
Treat a tool's description as untrusted text from the server
Auto-approve every call to servers the user installed themselves

questions.explanation: Visible arguments, bounded waits with notifications/cancelled, and scepticism about server-supplied text are all endorsed. Installation is not standing approval, and re-fetching each turn ignores ttlMs and list_changed and wrecks prompt caching.
